**Auto-generated by `scripta/generate-factory-readme.py` — do not edit by hand.**

Inventory of every goal directory under `docs/factory/` with its declared
status (goal-status audit vocabulary: `done` / `active` / `planned` /
`unknown`) and per-type document counts. Status is read from `goal.md`
(fallback `CAMPAIGN.md`) via the same classifier as the goal-status audit.

`Done` estimates completion from structured Status-column phase tables in the
goal's docs (ledger, delivery specs, stage tables): complete rows / total rows
of the largest table. A goal declared `done` is 100%. `—` when no phase table
exists (unknown, not zero).

Goals marked `done` that are still in `docs/factory/` are listed under
Archived — move them to `docs/archived/` with `git mv`. Closed-out goals live
in [`docs/archived/`](../archived/README.md).
